[[Club San José|San José]] were the defending champions, having won the [[2018 FBF División Profesional#Torneo Clausura|2018 Clausura]] tournament. In the Torneo Apertura, [[Club Bolívar|Bolívar]] won their twenty-ninth league title and twenty-third in the professional era, with two matches to spare following a 2–1 victory over [[Oriente Petrolero]] on 16 May,{{cite news|url=https://www.diez.bo//futbol/Bolivar-se-corono-campeon-del-Apertura-tras-ganarle-a-Oriente-por-1-2-20190516-0023.html|title=Bolívar se coronó campeón del Apertura tras ganarle a Oriente por 1-2|date=16 May 2019|publisher=diez.bo|language=Spanish}} while in the Torneo Clausura, [[C.D. Jorge Wilstermann|Jorge Wilstermann]] won their fifteenth league title and eighth in the professional era following a 3–1 win against Oriente Petrolero on the last matchday of the tournament on 28 December.{{cite news|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/161101_wilstermann-campeon-del-clausura-2019|title=Wilstermann, campeón del Clausura 2019|publisher=El Deber|date=28 December 2019|language=Spanish}} ==Format== The season was split into a ''Torneo Apertura'' and a ''Torneo Clausura'', played in the first and second half of the year, respectively. Both were played under a double round-robin system, with all teams playing each other twice for a total of 26 matches. The teams placed first at the end of each tournament were the champions and earned qualification for the [[2020 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] group stage. The remaining two Copa Libertadores berths as well as the four Copa Sudamericana ones were awarded through the aggregate table.{{cite news|url=https://www.diez.bo//futbol/Premios-solo-para-el-campeon-y-lo-demas-a-la-tabla-acumulada-20181214-0002.html|title=Premios solo para el campeón y lo demás a la tabla acumulada|date=14 December 2018|publisher=diez.bo|language=Spanish}} ==Teams== The number of teams for the 2019 season remained the same as the 2018 season.
